interface.name: zwwm_decoration_manager_v1
interface.description: Reports the compositor's preferred decoration mode. Clients use this information to enable or disable their titlebars, borders, and shadows. The compositor controls the selected mode and may reject a preference. This protocol is independent of KDE server-decoration. Clients should select either this protocol or xdg-decoration for an individual surface.

entry.name: invalid_surface
entry.summary: surface is not a live client-owned wl_surface

request.name: get_decoration

description.summary: create a surface decoration policy object

request.description: The compositor sends configure immediately after creation. A client must disable its own decorations when server_side is selected and apply that choice on its next surface commit. Destroying the manager does not destroy existing surface decoration objects.

event.name: default_mode

description.summary: preferred mode for newly created surfaces

event.description: Sent immediately after binding. It lets clients choose decorations before constructing or mapping their windows. Per-surface configure events are authoritative if they differ from this default.

request.name: set_mode
request.description: The compositor replies with configure containing its selected mode, even if it rejects the requested preference. Requests do not require an xdg_toplevel and may be made before mapping the wl_surface.
